title: ArcEvents physical mystery box and repairable barricades, 2026-11-05
assumptions: Current observed Spawn/Survival runtime ArcEvents0.5.43. Source and shared host rules retain starting500, existing kill/wave awards, mystery price650 and the existing single exclusive draw excluding the current weapon. No price, weight, award, magazine or damage value changes.

Low/base/high are scenarios, not telemetry: one solo run per player-day with5/8/10 cleared waves and gross9400/18775/27175 local points.1/5/20 participating players, no stacking of mutually exclusive games.

One/eight/twenty-four charged box openings per run spend650/5200/15600 points. Remaining8750/13575/11575 expire. A normal abandoned revealed weapon does not refund, preventing free rerolls. Technical cancellation releases the same reservation at most once; it does not mint a new award.

Repairing three-board ingress windows is free and awards no points, items, XP or entitlement. Bounded one-board repair takes1.5seconds and hostile breach strikes take2seconds. Fixed arena windows are not ordinary-world construction.

Both before and after, all local points and event weapons expire at match restoration. Barricades alter survival difficulty and opening latency changes purchase cadence, neither creates a permanent payout.
Vault, premium tokens, XP, ordinary ammunition and the current SELL/future SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged. No assumed exchange rate or global economy repricing.

Maximum repeat/alternate-account activity cannot export box weapons or repair rewards: no repair awards, match-ID equipment, exact escrow restoration and same-match authority. Box reservation, claim, timeout, double-click, owner quit, technical failure and close need focused checks.

flows.basis: Exact inherited solo wave5/8/10 upper-wallet scenarios; awards do not change.
One exclusive paid draw at650, unchanged price. Ordinary expiry remains spent. Technical cancellation reverses only its original reservation.
